_comment: Each row is an operation that is legitimate BY DECISION, with the reason it is.
The denial-differential gate fails a PR that makes any of these newly refused.
verify_fix.py reads; this fixture is what denial-differential.yml classifies
until the adopting change points its corpus_path at that file, folds the rows
only this fixture carries into it, and deletes this file (tracked in #9678).
kind: shell rows are classified; flow and cron rows are recorded and reported as
skipped, because neither has a single command line to hand a matcher.
A row is classified against the WHOLE deny composite the tool gate applies to a
shell command: the path fence, the IMDS/env-credential detectors, the exfil
shapes, and the rule catalog with its argv floors.

golden_paths.reason: Read-only PR status query -- every drive-to-green round starts with it.
Read-only issue enumeration used by the triage and scanner crons.
Read-only diff fetch -- how a review lane reads a change as data.
Explicitly-named feature-branch push. Allowed by policy; only protected branches are fenced.
Lease-guarded feature-branch force push -- the sanctioned way to update a PR round.
Read-only history read -- the basis of every archaeology step.
Read-only remote sync before a rebase.
Base-ref probe worktree -- the sanctioned alternative to checking out over live work.
A repo gate the agent runs locally before every push.
A blocking CI gate, run locally first.
The frontend lint ratchet, run at CI's exact ceiling.
Own-health read. Named here because the self-protection floor is the rule most often tightened.
Read-only enumeration of installed jobs, across the same self-protection surface.
Read-only directory listing over the governance tree -- a repeat false-positive source.
The Windows equivalent read-only listing; proves the fence is not POSIX-shaped.
Starting a chat session must never be refused; classified by the flow gate, not this one.
An installed scanner job must keep firing; classified by the cron gate, not this one.
